title: NIFTY Pharma P/E Ratio
description: The NIFTY Pharma index carried a P/E ratio of 39.8 on 14 Oct, 2026, reflecting valuations across India's drugmakers. Pharma valuations often respond to export demand, regulatory approvals, and R&D pipeline strength.
